method: Each New York location address was submitted once with street, city, state NY and ZIP from a browser on November 1, 2026. The street is the first comma-separated part of the directory address that begins with a number (suite and plaza text dropped). Coordinates are rounded to six decimals. The importer accepts a result only when one candidate names the same house number and street and the Census county matches the regulator's county.
limitations: Census geocoding places an address along a street segment. The point is approximate, not the storefront, and supports only straight-line distance sorting. County shown on the site remains the regulator's.
